title: Analysis code: Plasma extracellular vesicle-derived microRNAs associated with overall survival in advanced non-targeted NSCLC (pilot study)
description: R and Python code for the analyses in "Plasma Extracellular Vesicle-Derived MicroRNAs Associated with Overall Survival in Advanced Non-Targeted NSCLC: A Pilot Study": discovery of candidate plasma EV miRNAs (differential expression, univariate Cox, random survival forest, LASSO-penalized Cox), bootstrap internal validation, clinical factor models, sensitivity analyses, exploratory TCGA analyses and target pathway enrichment. No patient data are included; the NanoString nCounter data and de-identified clinical characteristics are in NCBI GEO under accession GSE352464.
